description: Synthetic infeasible case where the budget is below the cheapest available short-term monthly resource.

generation_input.summary: Kasus sintetis untuk membuktikan penghentian generation ketika tidak ada satu pun resource yang dapat dialokasikan dalam budget.
generation_input.additional_notes: Jangan membuat HTML jika allocation tidak feasible setelah tiga iterasi.

assertions: Reject every allocation because the cheapest valid one-month resource costs 7200000 IDR.
Return budget_unfeasible after at most three allocation attempts.
Do not compose HTML or expose budget_maximum in a client-facing artifact.
